# Introduction

This document performs a multi-term literature search on Google Scholar using the SerpApi service. It iterates through a vector of search queries, aggregates the results into a single data frame, and generates a single RIS file containing unique papers across all search terms. Using SerpApi avoids the need for complex scraping strategies and helps bypass CAPTCHAs and other blocks.

# How to Resume a Search

If a search is interrupted by a connectivity issue or other failure, it can be resumed from the last saved checkpoint:

1. Locate the most recent `.rds` checkpoint file in the `output/lit_search/` directory. These files are timestamped (UTC), e.g., `search_state_20250522_143000.rds`.
2. In the **Set Search Parameters** section below:
   - Set `resume_search <- TRUE`.
   - Copy the path to the latest checkpoint file into `checkpoint_to_resume`, for example: `checkpoint_to_resume <- here::here("output/lit_search/search_state_20250522_143000.rds")`.
3. Restart the program by rendering the document again. The program will load the results obtained so far and skip the search terms that have already been completed.

# Set Search Parameters

```{r search-parameters}
# Maximum number of papers to retrieve for each search query (Fixed limit)
# Default is 20
paper_limit <- 100

# Number of papers to include in summaries, results table, and RIS output file
# Default is 20
paper_output <- 100

#Search queries
search_queries <- read_csv(queries_path)

# Resumption Settings
# TRUE: Resume a search from a checkpoint file
# FALSE: Start a new search (Default)
resume_search <- TRUE

# Path to the .rds checkpoint file to resume from
# Example: here::here("output/lit_search/search_state_20250522_143000.rds")
checkpoint_to_resume <- "search_state_20260501_233056.rds"

# Dynamic Papers Limit Settings
# TRUE: Calculate the number of papers to retrieve based on total matches
# FALSE: Use the fixed 'paper_limit' (Default)
use_dynamic_papers_limit <- FALSE

# Fraction of total matches to retrieve (Default 0.1)
dynamic_fraction <- 0.1

# Minimum number of papers to retrieve (Default 20)
# If total matches < dynamic_min, all matches are retrieved.
dynamic_min <- 20

# Maximum number of papers to retrieve for any single search (Default 200)
dynamic_max <- 200

# Full Abstract Lookup (Semantic Scholar)
# TRUE: Attempt to fetch the full abstract from Semantic Scholar by paper title
# FALSE: Use the snippet/sentence fragment from Google Scholar (Default)
use_full_abstract_lookup <- TRUE
```

# Define Robust Search Function

```{r robust-serp-search}
# Function to query Google Scholar via SerpApi with retry logic
# To use your SerpApi key:
# 1. Open your .Renviron file (e.g., using usethis::edit_r_environ())
# 2. Add a line: SERPAPI_API_KEY="your_actual_key_here"
# 3. Restart your R session
robust_serp_search <- function(query, start_idx = 0, num = 20, log_file = NULL) {
  base_url <- "https://serpapi.com/search"

  # Check for API key in environment
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("SERPAPI_API_KEY")
  if (api_key == "") {
    log_progress("SERPAPI_API_KEY not found in environment variables.", log_file)
    return(NULL)
  }

  retries <- 0
  max_retries <- 3

  while (retries <= max_retries) {
    # Perform the GET request
    res <- GET(
      url = base_url,
      query = list(
        engine = "google_scholar",
        q = query,
        api_key = api_key,
        start = start_idx,
        num = num,
        hl = "en"
      )
    )

    # Check status
    if (status_code(res) == 200) {
      # Success: parse and return JSON
      # We use simplifyVector = FALSE for predictable nested list structures
      return(fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE))
    } else if (status_code(res) == 429) {
      # Rate limited: wait and retry with exponential backoff
      wait_time <- 2^retries + runif(1, 2, 5)
      log_progress(sprintf("HTTP 429: Too Many Requests. Retrying in %.2f seconds...", wait_time), log_file)
      Sys.sleep(wait_time)
      retries <- retries + 1
    } else {
      # Other error: record and return NULL
      err_msg <- try(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), silent = TRUE)
      log_progress(sprintf("SerpApi request failed with status %d: %s",
                   status_code(res),
                   if (inherits(err_msg, "try-error")) "Could not parse error message" else err_msg), log_file)
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  log_progress("Max retries exceeded for SerpApi.", log_file)
  return(NULL)
}

# Function to lookup full metadata (abstract, journal, DOI) from Semantic Scholar by title
# Uses a two-stage approach: quoted search for exact match, then unquoted search with validation
lookup_s2_metadata <- function(title, log_file = NULL) {
  if (is.null(title) || is.na(title) || title == "") return(NULL)

  # Clean title for better matching: remove [HTML], [PDF] tags and extra whitespace
  clean_title <- str_remove_all(title, "\\[.*?\\]") %>% str_trim()
  norm_target <- str_to_lower(str_replace_all(clean_title, "[^[:alnum:]]", ""))

  base_url <- "https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/search"

  # Check for API key in environment
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY")
  headers <- if (api_key != "") c(`x-api-key` = api_key) else NULL

  # Internal helper to execute a query and validate results
  execute_s2_query <- function(q_text, is_quoted = FALSE) {
    retries <- 0
    while (retries <= 2) {
      Sys.sleep(1 + runif(1, 0, 1))
      res <- try(GET(
        url = base_url,
        query = list(
          query = q_text,
          limit = if (is_quoted) 1 else 3,
          fields = "abstract,title,journal,venue,externalIds"
        ),
        add_headers(.headers = headers),
        timeout(10)
      ), silent = TRUE)

      if (inherits(res, "try-error")) return(NULL)

      if (status_code(res) == 200) {
        content_json <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
        if (!is.null(content_json$data) && length(content_json$data) > 0) {
          # Check all candidates
          for (candidate in content_json$data) {
            s2_title <- as.character(candidate$title %||% "")
            norm_s2 <- str_to_lower(str_replace_all(s2_title, "[^[:alnum:]]", ""))
            if (norm_target == norm_s2 || str_detect(norm_s2, fixed(norm_target)) || str_detect(norm_target, fixed(norm_s2))) {
               # Extract journal name
               j_info <- candidate$journal
               j_name <- if (is.list(j_info) && !is.null(j_info$name)) as.character(j_info$name) else as.character(candidate$venue %||% NA_character_)

               # Extract DOI
               doi <- candidate$externalIds$DOI %||% NA_character_

               return(list(
                 abstract = as.character(candidate$abstract %||% NA_character_),
                 journal = j_name,
                 doi = doi
               ))
            }
          }
        }
        return("NOT_FOUND")
      } else if (status_code(res) == 429) {
        Sys.sleep(5 * (retries + 1))
        retries <- retries + 1
      } else {
        return(NULL)
      }
    }
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Stage 1: Quoted Search (Exact Match)
  log_progress(sprintf("  Attempting exact match for: %s", clean_title), log_file)
  result <- execute_s2_query(paste0("\"", clean_title, "\""), is_quoted = TRUE)

  if (is.list(result)) {
    log_progress("    Success: Exact match found.", log_file)
    return(result)
  }

  # Stage 2: Unquoted Search (Fuzzy Match)
  log_progress("    Exact match failed. Attempting fuzzy match...", log_file)
  result <- execute_s2_query(clean_title, is_quoted = FALSE)

  if (is.list(result)) {
    log_progress("    Success: Fuzzy match validated.", log_file)
    return(result)
  } else if (identical(result, "NOT_FOUND")) {
    log_progress("    Failed: Paper not found or no confident match.", log_file)
  } else {
    log_progress("    Failed: API error or rate limit.", log_file)
  }

  return(NULL)
}

# Function to lookup full journal name from CrossRef by DOI
lookup_crossref_journal <- function(doi, log_file = NULL) {
  if (is.null(doi) || is.na(doi) || doi == "") return(NULL)

  base_url <- "https://api.crossref.org/works/"
  url <- paste0(base_url, doi)

  res <- try(GET(url, timeout(10)), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(res, "try-error") || status_code(res) != 200) return(NULL)

  content_json <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

  if (!is.null(content_json$message) &&
      !is.null(content_json$message$`container-title`) &&
      length(content_json$message$`container-title`) > 0) {
    j_name <- content_json$message$`container-title`[[1]]
    if (!is.null(j_name) && !is.na(j_name) && j_name != "") return(as.character(j_name))
  }

  return(NULL)
}
```

# Define Processing Functions

In this section, we define the data structures and functions needed to handle the search results from SerpApi.

```{r define-processing-functions}
# Function to convert paper data to RIS format
create_ris_record <- function(paper) {
  ris <- "TY  - JOUR"

  if (!is.null(paper[["title"]]) && !is.na(paper[["title"]])) {
    ris <- c(ris, paste0("TI  - ", paper[["title"]]))
  }

  authors <- unlist(paper[["authors"]])
  if (length(authors) > 0) {
    for (auth_name in authors) {
      if (auth_name != "" && !is.na(auth_name)) {
        ris <- c(ris, paste0("AU  - ", auth_name))
      }
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(paper[["year"]]) && !is.na(paper[["year"]])) {
    ris <- c(ris, paste0("PY  - ", paper[["year"]]))
  }

  journal_info <- paper[["journal"]]
  journal_name <- if (is.list(journal_info)) as.character(journal_info[["name"]] %||% NA_character_) else as.character(journal_info)
  if (is.na(journal_name) || journal_name == "") journal_name <- as.character(paper[["venue"]] %||% NA_character_)
  if (!is.na(journal_name) && journal_name != "") ris <- c(ris, paste0("JO  - ", journal_name))

  ext_ids <- paper[["externalIds"]]
  if (is.list(ext_ids) && !is.null(ext_ids[["DOI"]]) && !is.na(ext_ids[["DOI"]])) ris <- c(ris, paste0("DO  - ", ext_ids[["DOI"]]))

  if (!is.null(paper[["abstract"]]) && !is.na(paper[["abstract"]])) {
    clean_abstract <- str_replace_all(as.character(paper[["abstract"]]), "\\s+", " ")
    ris <- c(ris, paste0("AB  - ", clean_abstract))
  }

  # Add M2 tag with search rank information
  rank <- paper[["highest_search_rank"]]
  if (is.null(rank) || is.na(rank)) rank <- paper[["search_rank"]]

  if (!is.null(rank) && !is.na(rank)) {
    formatted_rank <- sprintf("%04d", as.integer(rank))
    ris <- c(ris, paste0("M2  - search_rank: ", formatted_rank))
  }

  ris <- c(ris, "ER  - ")
  return(paste(ris, collapse = "\n"))
}

# Ensure the output directory exists
output_dir <- here::here("output", "lit_search")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Function to log progress with UTC timestamps
log_progress <- function(msg, log_file = NULL) {
  ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  formatted_msg <- sprintf("[%s UTC] %s", ts, msg)
  message(formatted_msg)
  if (!is.null(log_file)) {
    cat(formatted_msg, "\n", file = log_file, append = TRUE)
  }
}

# Function to aggregate results and save to timestamped files
save_search_outputs <- function(results_list, session_timestamp) {
  if (length(results_list) == 0) return(NULL)

  # 1. Aggregate results
  combined_full_data <- map(results_list, ~ .x$full_data) %>% bind_rows()
  combined_search_results <- map(results_list, ~ .x$display_data) %>% bind_rows()

  # # Apply Comeau filtering if needed
  # if (exists("use_comeau_query") && use_comeau_query) {
  #   combined_search_results <- combined_search_results %>%
  #     filter(str_detect(authors_full, regex("Comeau", ignore_case = TRUE)))
  #   combined_full_data <- combined_full_data %>%
  #     filter(title %in% combined_search_results$title)
  # }

  search_summary_data <- map(results_list, ~ .x$summary) %>% bind_rows() %>% filter(!is.na(total_matches))

  # 2. Deduplicate
  unique_full_data <- combined_full_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(title)) %>%
    group_by(title, year) %>%
    mutate(
      associated_queries = paste(unique(search_query), collapse = "; "),
      highest_search_rank = min(search_rank)
    ) %>%
    arrange(search_rank) %>%
    slice(1) %>% ungroup()

  unique_papers <- combined_search_results %>%
    filter(!is.na(title)) %>%
    group_by(title, publication_year) %>%
    mutate(
      associated_queries = paste(unique(search_query), collapse = "; "),
      highest_search_rank = min(search_rank)
    ) %>%
    arrange(search_rank) %>%
    slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>% relocate(associated_queries, highest_search_rank, .after = last_col())

  # 3. Filter for output limit
  out_limit <- if (exists("paper_output")) paper_output else 20
  unique_full_data_output <- unique_full_data %>% filter(search_rank <= out_limit)
  unique_papers_output <- unique_papers %>% filter(search_rank <= out_limit)

  # 4. Generate file paths
  # file_prefix <- if (exists("use_comeau_query") && use_comeau_query) "comeau_" else ""
  ris_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "unique_results_", session_timestamp, ".ris"))
  summary_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "search_summary_", session_timestamp, ".csv"))
  unique_csv_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "unique_papers_", session_timestamp, ".csv"))
  rds_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("search_state_", session_timestamp, ".rds"))

  # 5. Write files
  unique_ris_output <- unique_full_data_output %>% purrr::transpose() %>% map_chr(create_ris_record) %>% paste(collapse = "\n\n")
  write_lines(unique_ris_output, ris_path)
  write_csv(search_summary_data, summary_path)
  write_csv(unique_papers, unique_csv_path)
  saveRDS(results_list, rds_path)

  return(list(
    unique_full_data_output = unique_full_data_output,
    unique_papers_output = unique_papers_output,
    final_search_summary = search_summary_data,
    combined_full_data = combined_full_data,
    combined_search_results = combined_search_results
  ))
}

# Define prototype tibbles with expected columns to ensure consistency even when empty
# authors is a list of character vectors
full_data_ptype <- tibble(
  title = character(), authors = list(), year = integer(), publicationTypes = list(),
  journal = list(), externalIds = list(), abstract = character(), venue = character(),
  search_query = character(), search_rank = integer()
)

display_data_ptype <- tibble(
  search_query = character(), first_author_last_name = character(),
  publication_year = integer(), title = character(), journal_name = character(),
  authors_full = character(), publication_type = character(),
  search_rank = integer(), abstract = character(), doi = character()
)

summary_ptype <- tibble(search_query = character(), total_matches = integer())

# Function to execute search and process data for a single query
process_search_term <- function(query, log_file = NULL) {
  log_progress(paste("Searching for:", query), log_file)

  # Initial limit based on fixed parameter (may be updated if dynamic is enabled)
  limit_to_use <- if (exists("paper_limit")) paper_limit else 20

  all_hits <- list()
  total_matches <- 0L
  start_idx <- 0

  while (length(all_hits) < limit_to_use) {
    search_results <- robust_serp_search(
      query = query,
      start_idx = start_idx,
      num = 20,
      log_file = log_file
    )

    # Handle failed search
    if (is.null(search_results)) {
      if (length(all_hits) == 0) {
        return(list(
          full_data = full_data_ptype,
          display_data = display_data_ptype,
          summary = tibble(search_query = query, total_matches = NA_integer_),
          failed = TRUE
        ))
      } else {
        break
      }
    }

    # Extract total matches once
    if (start_idx == 0) {
      search_info <- search_results[["search_information"]]
      if (is.list(search_info) && !is.null(search_info[["total_results"]])) {
        total_matches <- as.integer(search_info[["total_results"]])
      }
      log_progress(sprintf("  Found %d total matches.", total_matches), log_file)

      # Handle dynamic paper limit
      if (exists("use_dynamic_papers_limit") && use_dynamic_papers_limit) {
        # Calculate dynamic limit based on fraction, min, and max parameters
        frac <- if (exists("dynamic_fraction")) dynamic_fraction else 0.1
        min_p <- if (exists("dynamic_min")) dynamic_min else 20
        max_p <- if (exists("dynamic_max")) dynamic_max else 200

        if (total_matches < min_p) {
          limit_to_use <- total_matches
        } else {
          limit_to_use <- min(max_p, max(min_p, ceiling(total_matches * frac)))
        }
        log_progress(sprintf("  Dynamic limit calculated: retrieving up to %d papers.", limit_to_use), log_file)
      }
    }

    hits <- search_results[["organic_results"]]
    if (is.null(hits) || !is.list(hits) || length(hits) == 0) {
      log_progress("  No more organic results found.", log_file)
      break
    }

    all_hits <- c(all_hits, hits)
    log_progress(sprintf("  Retrieved %d results so far...", length(all_hits)), log_file)

    # Check if we've reached the limit
    if (length(all_hits) >= limit_to_use) {
      all_hits <- head(all_hits, limit_to_use)
      break
    }

    # Check if there's a next page
    pagination <- search_results[["serpapi_pagination"]]
    if (!is.list(pagination) || is.null(pagination[["next"]])) {
      break
    }

    start_idx <- start_idx + length(hits)
    Sys.sleep(runif(1, 1, 2))
  }

  if (length(all_hits) == 0) {
    return(list(
      full_data = full_data_ptype,
      display_data = display_data_ptype,
      summary = tibble(search_query = query, total_matches = total_matches),
      failed = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # Helper to reformat author names to "Lastname, Firstname Initials"
  reformat_author_name <- function(name) {
    if (is.null(name) || is.na(name) || name == "") return(NA_character_)
    name <- str_remove_all(name, "…") %>% str_trim()
    if (name == "") return(NA_character_)
    if (str_detect(name, ",")) return(name)
    parts <- str_split(name, "\\s+")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) > 1) {
      return(paste0(tail(parts, 1), ", ", paste(head(parts, -1), collapse = " ")))
    }
    return(name)
  }

  # Parse SerpApi results into the common schema
  parsed_data <- imap(all_hits, function(h, idx) {
    if (!is.list(h)) return(NULL)

    title <- if (!is.null(h[["title"]])) as.character(h[["title"]]) else NA_character_
    snippet <- if (!is.null(h[["snippet"]])) as.character(h[["snippet"]]) else NA_character_

    # Safely extract publication info
    pub_info <- h[["publication_info"]]
    summary_str <- if (is.list(pub_info) && !is.null(pub_info[["summary"]])) {
      as.character(pub_info[["summary"]])
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }

    # Extract year
    year_regex <- "\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b"
    year <- if (!is.na(summary_str)) as.integer(str_extract(summary_str, year_regex)) else NA_integer_

    # Authors parsing
    # We aggregate authors from both 'authors' list and 'summary' string
    names_found <- character()

    # 1. Extract from structured 'authors' list
    authors_data <- if (is.list(pub_info)) pub_info[["authors"]] else NULL
    if (is.list(authors_data) && length(authors_data) > 0) {
      names_found <- map_chr(authors_data, function(auth) {
        if (is.list(auth)) as.character(auth[["name"]] %||% "") else as.character(auth)
      })
    }

    # 2. Extract from 'summary' string (which often has more authors)
    if (!is.na(summary_str)) {
      authors_str_raw <- str_split(summary_str, "\\s+-\\s+")[[1]][1]
      names_from_summary <- str_split(authors_str_raw, ",")[[1]] %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_remove_all("\\.\\.\\.") %>%
        str_trim()
      names_found <- unique(c(names_found, names_from_summary))
    }

    # Reformat all names
    authors_final_vec <- names_found %>%
      discard(~ .x == "") %>%
      map_chr(reformat_author_name) %>%
      discard(is.na) %>%
      unique()

    # Journal parsing
    parts <- if (!is.na(summary_str)) str_split(summary_str, "\\s+-\\s+")[[1]] else character()
    journal_info <- if (length(parts) >= 2) {
      j <- str_remove(parts[2], ",?\\s*\\b\\d{4}\\b") %>% str_trim()
      if (j == "") NA_character_ else j
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }

    # Lookup full metadata from Semantic Scholar if requested
    s2_metadata <- if (exists("use_full_abstract_lookup") && use_full_abstract_lookup) {
      # Clean title to remove prefixes like [HTML] or [PDF]
      lookup_title <- str_remove_all(title, "\\[.*?\\]") %>% str_trim()
      lookup_s2_metadata(lookup_title, log_file = log_file)
    } else {
      NULL
    }

    # Use Authoritative journal name if available and Google Scholar version looks truncated
    # Priority: CrossRef (via DOI) > Semantic Scholar > Google Scholar
    final_journal <- journal_info
    found_doi <- NA_character_

    if (is.list(s2_metadata)) {
      s2_j <- s2_metadata$journal
      s2_abs <- s2_metadata$abstract
      found_doi <- s2_metadata$doi

      # Try CrossRef if we have a DOI
      cr_j <- if (!is.na(found_doi)) lookup_crossref_journal(found_doi, log_file = log_file) else NULL

      # Check for truncation in GS journal name (literal ... or Unicode …)
      is_gs_truncated <- is.na(journal_info) || str_detect(journal_info, "\\.\\.\\.|…")

      if (is_gs_truncated) {
        if (!is.null(cr_j)) {
          final_journal <- cr_j
        } else if (!is.null(s2_j) && !is.na(s2_j)) {
          final_journal <- s2_j
        }
      }
    }

    # Final cleanup: strip any residual ellipses from the chosen name
    if (!is.na(final_journal)) {
      final_journal <- str_remove_all(final_journal, "\\.\\.\\.|…") %>% str_trim()
    }

    # Construct the paper tibble (1 row)
    tibble(
      title = title,
      authors = list(authors_final_vec),
      year = year,
      publicationTypes = list("Journal Article"),
      journal = list(list(name = final_journal)),
      externalIds = list(list(DOI = found_doi)),
      abstract = if (is.list(s2_metadata) && !is.null(s2_metadata$abstract) && !is.na(s2_metadata$abstract)) s2_metadata$abstract else snippet,
      venue = final_journal,
      search_query = query,
      search_rank = as.integer(idx)
    )
  }) %>% compact()

  if (length(parsed_data) == 0) {
    return(list(
      full_data = full_data_ptype,
      display_data = display_data_ptype,
      summary = tibble(search_query = query, total_matches = total_matches),
      failed = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # Combine rows
  data_norm <- bind_rows(parsed_data)

  # Process into final display dataframe format
  papers_df <- data_norm %>%
    mutate(
      first_author_last_name = map_chr(authors, function(auth_vec) {
        if (length(auth_vec) == 0) return(NA_character_)
        full_name <- auth_vec[1]
        str_split(full_name, ",")[[1]] %>% head(1) %>% str_trim()
      }),
      journal_name = map_chr(journal, function(j) {
        if (is.list(j)) as.character(j[["name"]] %||% NA_character_) else as.character(j)
      }),
      authors_full = map_chr(authors, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
      publication_type = map_chr(publicationTypes, ~ paste(unlist(.x), collapse = ", ")),
      doi = map_chr(externalIds, function(ids) {
        if (is.list(ids)) as.character(ids[["DOI"]] %||% NA_character_) else NA_character_
      })
    ) %>%
    select(
      search_query,
      first_author_last_name,
      publication_year = year,
      title,
      journal_name,
      authors_full,
      publication_type,
      search_rank,
      abstract,
      doi
    )

  return(list(
    full_data = data_norm,
    display_data = papers_df,
    summary = tibble(search_query = query, total_matches = total_matches),
    failed = FALSE
  ))
}
```


# Perform Search

```{r run-search-queries}
# 1. Session Initialization
session_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", tz = "UTC")
current_log_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("search_log_", session_timestamp, ".txt"))
search_start_time <- Sys.time()

log_progress(paste("Starting search session:", session_timestamp), current_log_file)

# Prepare queries to run
queries_to_run <- search_queries %>% sample()
if (exists("queries_limit") && !is.null(queries_limit)) queries_to_run <- head(queries_to_run, queries_limit)

search_results_list <- list()

# 2. Resumption Logic
if (exists("resume_search") && resume_search && exists("checkpoint_to_resume") && checkpoint_to_resume != "") {
  if (file.exists(checkpoint_to_resume)) {
    log_progress(paste("Resuming search from checkpoint:", checkpoint_to_resume), current_log_file)
    search_results_list <- readRDS(checkpoint_to_resume)
    completed_queries <- map_chr(search_results_list, ~ .x$summary$search_query)
    queries_to_run <- setdiff(queries_to_run, completed_queries)
    log_progress(sprintf("Loaded %d completed results. %d queries remaining.", length(search_results_list), length(queries_to_run)), current_log_file)
  } else {
    log_progress(paste("Checkpoint file not found:", checkpoint_to_resume, ". Starting from scratch."), current_log_file)
  }
}

# 3. Execute Search Loop
if (length(queries_to_run) > 0) {
  for (q in queries_to_run) {
    res <- process_search_term(q, log_file = current_log_file)
    search_results_list <- c(search_results_list, list(res))

    # Periodic Save
    log_progress("Saving intermediate results...", current_log_file)
    save_search_outputs(search_results_list, session_timestamp)

    Sys.sleep(runif(1, 2, 5))
  }
} else {
  log_progress("No new queries to run.", current_log_file)
}

search_end_time <- Sys.time()
search_duration <- search_end_time - search_start_time
log_progress(sprintf("Search session completed in: %.2f %s", search_duration, attr(search_duration, "units")), current_log_file)
```

# Aggregate and Deduplicate Results

```{r aggregate-and-deduplicate}
# Final save and result extraction
final_outputs <- save_search_outputs(search_results_list, session_timestamp)

if (!is.null(final_outputs)) {
  unique_full_data_output <- final_outputs$unique_full_data_output
  unique_papers_output <- final_outputs$unique_papers_output
  search_summary_data <- final_outputs$final_search_summary
  combined_full_data <- final_outputs$combined_full_data
  combined_search_results <- final_outputs$combined_search_results
} else {
  unique_full_data_output <- full_data_ptype
  unique_papers_output <- display_data_ptype
  search_summary_data <- summary_ptype
  combined_full_data <- full_data_ptype
  combined_search_results <- display_data_ptype
}

failed_queries_data <- map(search_results_list, function(res) {
  if (res$failed) return(res$summary %>% select(search_query))
  return(NULL)
}) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()
if (nrow(failed_queries_data) == 0) failed_queries_data <- tibble(search_query = character())
```


# Search Summary

```{r search-summary}
unique_term_summary <- unique_papers_output %>%
  separate_longer_delim(associated_queries, delim = "; ") %>%
  count(associated_queries, name = "retrieved_unique_papers")

final_search_summary <- search_summary_data %>%
  left_join(unique_term_summary, by = c("search_query" = "associated_queries")) %>%
  mutate(retrieved_unique_papers = coalesce(retrieved_unique_papers, 0L))

final_search_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Literature Search Summary (SerpApi)",
    subtitle = "Total database matches and retrieved unique papers per search term"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(.list = list(search_query = "Search Query", total_matches = "Total Matches", retrieved_unique_papers = "Unique Papers"))
```

# Unique Paper Statistics

```{r unique-paper-stats}
total_unique <- nrow(unique_papers_output)
most_represented <- if (nrow(unique_term_summary) > 0) {
  unique_term_summary %>% filter(retrieved_unique_papers == max(retrieved_unique_papers)) %>% summarize(term = paste(associated_queries, collapse = "; "), count = first(retrieved_unique_papers))
} else { tibble(term = NA_character_, count = 0L) }
least_represented <- if (nrow(unique_term_summary) > 0) {
  unique_term_summary %>% filter(retrieved_unique_papers == min(retrieved_unique_papers)) %>% summarize(term = paste(associated_queries, collapse = "; "), count = first(retrieved_unique_papers))
} else { tibble(term = NA_character_, count = 0L) }

tibble(Metric = c("Total Unique Papers", "Most Represented Search Term(s)", "Least Represented Search Term(s)"), Value = c(as.character(total_unique), paste0(most_represented$term, " (", most_represented$count, " papers)"), paste0(least_represented$term, " (", least_represented$count, " papers)"))) %>%
  gt() %>% tab_header(title = "Unique Paper Overview")
```

# Display Results

```{r display-unique-results}
unique_papers_output %>%
  select(any_of(c("highest_search_rank", "first_author_last_name", "publication_year", "title", "associated_queries", "journal_name"))) %>%
  arrange(highest_search_rank) %>%
  gt() %>% tab_header(title = "Unique Search Results", subtitle = paste0("Total Unique Papers: ", nrow(unique_papers_output))) %>%
  cols_label(.list = list(highest_search_rank = "Highest Rank", first_author_last_name = "Author", publication_year = "Year", title = "Title", journal_name = "Journal", associated_queries = "Associated Queries"))
```


# Failed Searches

```{r failed-searches}
if (nrow(failed_queries_data) > 0) {
  failed_queries_data %>% gt() %>% tab_header(title = "Failed Search Terms") %>% cols_label(.list = list(search_query = "Search Query"))
} else { cat("All search terms were successfully queried.") }
```
